subject.title: [Telegram] 机器人头像更改后无法同步到 Telegram 客户端

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in Telegram bot profile-photo sync/action, or keep assistant avatar overrides browser-local with manual BotFather updates?
rationale: The code path is feasible, but it changes public bot branding and may upload local/browser avatar data to Telegram, so automation should not choose the UX, privacy, and config boundary alone.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in Telegram action/sync
options.body: Implement a Telegram-plugin-owned `setMyProfilePhoto` path behind a disabled-by-default setting or UI confirmation, with docs and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep avatar overrides browser-local
options.body: Document that Control UI assistant avatar overrides do not sync to Telegram and users should continue using BotFather for bot branding.

options.title: Defer until broader identity sync design
options.body: Keep this issue open as product design input until cross-channel agent identity sync has a shared privacy model.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in Telegram action/sync
recommendation.body: Implement a Telegram-plugin-owned `setMyProfilePhoto` path behind a disabled-by-default setting or UI confirmation, with docs and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is mainly a product/privacy choice at the Control UI plus Telegram boundary, and steipete is the recent merger/adjacent owner for the relevant UI and gateway-facing work.
